title: Detriment
wikitext:
'''Detriments''' are [[special]] cards similar to the [[Curse]] card, appearing in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion. Detriments bend the rules of the game slightly, making things harder.  Each Detriment has a certain event or situation described beneath the abilities it grants that ends the effect of the card.  If your [[investigator]] ever finds himself in that situation, he discards the Detriment.  For instance, an investigator with the [[Local Guide]] Detriment loses the card if he ever goes [[Insane]].  If another investigator already has a Detriment that you are told to draw, you must take it from that investigator.
